21475.d: Rellekka is a town in the Fremennik Province located by the Lunar Sea, serving as the region's capital.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Go north on the path between Seers' Village bank and Camelot.
• Fremennik sea boots 4 teleport directly to the Rellekka market square.
• Use the Fremennik Province lodestone and run west into the town.
• House Teleport or Teleport to house (chipped) to the POH portal just south of Rellekka.
• Enchanted lyre teleport to the town's south entrance.

21476.d: Rellekka is a music track that is unlocked at Rellekka.

21477.d: The Rellekka Hunter area is a Hunter training area located northeast of Rellekka near the entrance to the dwarven city of Keldagrim.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Teleporting to the Fremennik Province lodestone places players south of the Hunter area and east of Rellekka.
• The Arctic bear, a familiar available at level 71 summoning, can teleport the player to the area.
• Players can appear near Keldagrim via fairy ring DKS (called the Kandarin Snowy Hunter Area in the rings' network directory). The Rellekka Hunter area is north of the ring. Partial completion of the A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest is required to use the rings.
• The enchanted lyre, House Teleport (if the destination is set to Rellekka), and Rellekka tablet teleport players south of Rellekka. The Rellekka Hunter area is north-east of the city. The lyre requires completion of The Fremennik Trials quest, while the tablet requires completion of Love Story.
• Players can take the Keldagrim minecart system to Keldagrim, use the Dwarven Boatman to sail to Keldagrim's entrance, and then exit to the surface. The Rellekka Hunter area is north of the entrance. Partial completion of the quest The Giant Dwarf is required.
• Players can use the eagle transport system to fly to the Rellekka Hunter area. Completion of the Eagles' Peak quest as well as level 35 Agility is required. The polar eagles' eyrie is actually the closest of all transport means to the dungeon, but it is little used as all eagles' eyries are in remote locations.

21478.d: The Ice Cave, is also called Rellekka Hunter area dungeon is a pair of ice caverns found in the Rellekka Hunter area, under a rock near the northern coastline.

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
The entrance to the dungeon is not marked on either the mini-map or the world map.

There are several fast ways to get to the dungeon:
• Flying by polar eagle is the fastest way to reach the dungeon, as the entrance to their lair is directly east of its entrance.
• The arctic bear, a familiar available at level 71 Summoning, can teleport the player to the Trollweiss Hunter area.
• teleport to Fremennik Province lodestone and head north.
• Players can appear near Keldagrim via fairy ring code DKS (called the Kandarin: Snowy Hunter area in the rings' network directory). The Trollweiss Hunter area is north of the ring. Partial completion of the quest A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the rings.

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Rellekka Hunter area dungeon'

21574.d: Rex Matriarch lair is a dungeon located in Orthen.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• By activating the teleportation device in the spirit grove, leave the Anachronia base camp by following the directions to the arena below, upon using the lodestone run all the way east until arriving at the Matriarch lair door.
• By using an attuned boss portal in War's Retreat or the combat portal in the Max Guild, being teleported right in front of the Matriarch lair door.
• By casting the Eastern Anachronia Teleport spell from the standard spellbook requiring level 78 Magic, then going west.

Inside the Rex Matriarch lair:
• For the original three Rex Matriarchs, click to traverse the crumbled wall.
• For Osseous, click to teleport with the Osseous teleportation device to the eastern part of the lair, then click to cross the roots.

g.label: Access by teleportation device
g.how: {{Object map}} on wiki page 'Rex Matriarch lair'

21575.d: The Rex Matriarchs are four powerful female rex dinosaurs that were enhanced by Kerapac.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• By activating the Teleportation device in the Spirit Grove, directly east from the Anachronia base camp, then running all the way east until arriving at the Rex Matriarch lair door.
• By using a War's retreat attuned boss portal, being teleported right in front of the Rex Matriarch lair door.
